# dim_client_leads

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.dim_client_leads` · dbt area: `marketplace`

Dimension table for Client Leads, which are specific types of Contacts that came to us via the "Book With Us" form on the website and are distributed to advisors. Includes status workflow tracking, client preferences for destination / travel style / budget, and timestamp history of lifecycle transitions. Each row is a single Client Lead. Sourced from the Portal database.
